title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12754__PART_3_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12754__PART_3_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12754__PART_3_). This Indian Standard ( Part 3 ), which is identical with ISO 351 1/3 : 1984 Process measurement control functions and instrumentation — Symbolic representation — Part 3: Detailed symbols for instrument interconnection diagrams', issued by the international Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the BurfTatiTrf Indian Standards on 1 8 August 1989 on the recommendation of the Chemical Engineering Sectional Committee ( HMD 17/EDC 67 ) and approval of the Heavy Mechanical Engineering Division Council. Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. This standard is in four parts, as detailed in the Introduction. As in the Original Standard, this Page is Intentionally Left Blank IS 12754 (Part 3): 1989 180 3511/3:1984 Introduction

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
